channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: How to Choose a Rango Bridge Route
item.description: Choose a Rango bridge route by checking the destination network, expected output, fees and steps, then confirm the wallet requirements before signing.

item.title: Why Impermanent Loss Happens in a SushiSwap Pool
item.description: Impermanent loss is the value gap between holding two tokens and supplying them to a SushiSwap pool; price moves widen it, while fees can offset it.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin stablecoin on PayMe in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC launched RedCoin, its HKD stablecoin, on PayMe on Oct. 23, with wallets for more than 3.3 million users due to roll out over the following days.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin for PayMe users in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC launched RedCoin on PayMe on Oct. 23, opening HKD stablecoin payments to more than 3.3 million users and planning app-based tokenised investments.

item.title: Bitcoin Core speeds fixes for bugs AI can easily rediscover
item.description: Bitcoin Core added an easily discoverable category, directing fast fixes and advisories for bugs an LLM can find with minimal effort, while other flaws keep timed embargoes.

item.title: Ireland fines Coinbase unit €3.25 million over fund safeguards
item.description: Ireland’s central bank fined Coinbase Ireland €3.25 million over customer-fund safeguards and outsourcing, with the sanction awaiting High Court confirmation.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, replacing its consensus system
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet on Wednesday, Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT and targeting 150-millisecond finality, down from 12.8 seconds.

item.title: OCC rule leaves stablecoin reward programs in place
item.description: The OCC’s GENIUS Act rule bars stablecoin issuers from paying holders directly but leaves exchange rewards subject to case-by-case enforcement from Jan. 18.

item.title: NEAR proposal would cut issuance cap 36% over two years
item.description: NEAR’s HSP-029 proposal would lower the annual issuance cap from 2.5% to 1.6% over 24 months, reducing staking rewards and testing validator economics.

item.title: How to make a first Ethereum trade on fermi swap
item.description: A first fermi swap trade needs an Ethereum wallet, a token pair, enough ETH for gas and a checked quote; here is how approvals and execution work.

item.title: Solana Activates Alpenglow, Targeting 150ms Finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on mainnet on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT and targeting 150-millisecond finality; the rollout’s next phase, Rotor, remains unscheduled.

item.title: The right destination address for a bridge transfer
item.description: Choose a destination address you control on the receiving chain, then verify the network, token support and route-specific recipient rules before signing in your wallet.

item.title: OCC leaves stablecoin rewards to case-by-case review
item.description: The OCC’s first GENIUS Act rule leaves exchanges able to seek approval for stablecoin rewards, while issuers remain barred from paying holders directly.

item.title: TRON Energy requests should specify amount, address and duration
item.description: A useful request names the receiving address, Energy target, timing and lock terms; TRON delegation assigns resources, while the staked TRX stays with its owner.

item.title: How to show cross-chain transfer status in an app
item.description: Show cross-chain transfers as separate origin, bridge and destination states, with chain-specific evidence, timestamps and a clear rule for when the app says complete.

item.title: Anza activates Alpenglow on Solana, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Anza activated Alpenglow on Solana mainnet on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT and targeting finality in about 150 milliseconds, down from roughly 12.8 seconds.

item.title: Anza activates Alpenglow on Solana, targeting 150ms finality
item.description: Anza activated Alpenglow on Solana mainnet-beta on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT and targeting 150-millisecond transaction finality, down from 12.8 seconds.

item.title: SyncSwap pool types shape trades and liquidity risk
item.description: SyncSwap’s Classic, Stable and Aqua pools use different pricing curves, so pool choice affects swap slippage, liquidity exposure and how deposits are managed.

item.title: wormhole bridge transfer types: which fits your token?
item.description: Wormhole’s bridge routes tokens through wrapped transfers, native token transfers or CCTP; the right choice depends on token support, issuer control and destination chain.

item.title: JPMorgan brings JPM Coin to Ethereum for institutional clients
item.description: JPMorgan made JPM Coin available to institutional clients on Ethereum on Oct. 19, adding a second public network for bank deposits represented onchain.
